meta.title: CV | Daniel Peters
meta.description: CV and resume for Daniel Peters, UX & Product Design Consultant specializing in Agile Delivery and Complexity Reduction.

header.name: Daniel Peters
header.role: UX & Product Design Consultant | Certified Scrum Master
header.summary: Strategic Product Designer specializing in organizing chaos and breaking down complex requirements into lean, functional workflows. I bridge the gap between Product, Design, and Engineering by combining a core UX/UI focus with a certified Scrum Master background to drive efficient, high-velocity delivery.
header.coreRoles: Product Design · Agile Delivery (Scrum/SAFe) · Design Strategy

experience.title: Product Designer & Consultant
experience.summary: Acted as a hybrid between Product, Design, and Agile Management. Specialized in untangling messy enterprise processes and translating them into structured, shippable product increments.
bullets: Chaos Management: Organized fragmented data and compliance requirements into a centralized, lean workflow (Audi KoVoN), significantly reducing operational ambiguity.
Agile Execution: Leveraged Scrum Master expertise to align cross-functional teams, doubling sprint velocity by delivering high-precision, technically feasible UI specifications.
Process Optimization: Analyzed and restructured complex SAP-integrated workflows, stripping away bloat to save expert teams 2–4 hours of manual troubleshooting weekly.
Systemic Design: Scaled internal diagnostic tools by bridging the gap between business goals and engineering constraints, ensuring products are both user-centered and easy to build.

experience.title: UX/UI Product Designer
bullets: Lean Product Strategy: Helping tech founders translate vague ideas into structured, user-validated MVPs by focusing on core value and process efficiency.
End-to-End Execution: Designing high-fidelity prototypes and user journeys with a deep understanding of browser-based implementation and technical constraints.
Project Orchestration: Managing multi-stakeholder communication and lean budgets to ensure rapid go-live cycles.

experience.title: Co-Founder & Lead Organizer
bullets: Operational Leadership: Co-founded and scaled a cultural event to 3,000+ attendees by managing complex logistics, team operations, and vendor alignment.
Systemic Design: Oversaw all digital and physical touchpoints, ensuring a seamless and structured experience for attendees and staff alike.

experience.title: UX Design Intern
bullets: Requirement Synthesis: Translated complex user feedback and support data into concrete UX requirements and iterative screen concepts.
Evidence-based Testing: Validated health-tracking features through qualitative research to ensure high accessibility and user trust.
